title: Module Access
subtitle: Choose which modules each user can see and use. Changes reach their open sessions within seconds.
fullControlNote: Admin 1, Admin 2 and super admins always have every module, so they can never be locked out. Their access cannot be changed here.
selectUser: Select a user to manage their modules.
matrixHint: Tick a box to switch a module on or off for a user. Click a module name to change it for everyone listed.
legendCustom: Highlighted boxes differ from the role default. Locked rows are Admin 1 / Admin 2.
copyHint: {{name}} will get exactly the modules {{source}} has.
applyHint: Give the other {{count}} {{role}} users the same module access as {{name}}. Their current custom settings are replaced.
skipped: {{count}} admins with full control were left unchanged.
noAccessBody: An administrator has not given your account any module yet. Please contact Admin 1 or Admin 2.
